chunks: We subjugated the mountains with him; they glorified (God) in the evening and at sunrise.
ai.seo_question: Who were the mountains subjugated to glorify God with in the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Sad highlights the divine favor bestowed upon Prophet Dawud (David, peace be upon him), where the mountains joined him in glorifying God during the evening and sunrise. In Shia scholarly tradition, this natural submission is often interpreted as a sign of the Prophet's spiritual authority and the harmony of creation with the divine will, reflecting the concept of *Tasbih al-Khalq* (glorification by all beings).
